messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> INC-82491 // synthetic-prober-eu1 latency+5xx spike. More: https://pagerduty.example/INC-82491 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Alert routed to on-call: alice_m (primary), bob_sre (escalation). Trigger: prober failure rate > 10% over 3m window (eu1/eu2).
alice_m: acked and looking. I'm on it — grabbing logs from prober fleet.
bob_sre: I can help — will check gateway/edge logs for upstream resets.
carol_platform: seeing the same in the prober dashboard — fanout to eu1 and eu2. spike started ~05:12 UTC and is oscillating every 30–90s.
dave_infra: just saw a config push in egress rules at 05:10 UTC (jenkins job #deploy-1893). tagging that as suspicious.
emma_support: no inbound customer tickets yet; support channel silent. we should still communicate if this persists.
bob_sre: tailing logs now — lots of lines like:
```
2026-03-14T05:12:28Z prober-runner[pid=3421] ERROR upstream reset for target=canary-eu1 status=502 err="connection reset by peer"
2026-03-14T05:12:28Z prober-runner[pid=3421] WARN probe-retry attempt=2
```
carol_platform: also seeing 503s from the internal edge: `HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable` with `X-Route-Reason: conn-limits`.
alice_m: can we confirm whether user traffic is impacted or only synthetic checks?
emma_support: support confirm — user-facing metrics (prod-api-cpu, prod-5xx) are stable. looks isolated to synthetic path.
dave_infra: i'm going to revert that egress rule to the previous commit (deploy-1892) to test. rolling back now. command I'll run: 
```
# rollback egress change
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/egress-proxy --to-revision=1892
```
alice_m: please post the rollout ID when started.
dave_infra: rollback started at 05:20 UTC, rollout id: rollback-1892-2026-03-14.
ops_watchdog: auto-note: suppression threshold > 5 pages in 10m will trigger noise mitigation; monitoring suppression state.
bob_sre: after rollback I still see a small blip but the 5xx rate dropped from 14% -> 2% in eu1 within 3 minutes.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-82491 status changed to "Acknowledged" by alice_m.
emma_support: recommending we suppress synthetic alerts for 30m while system stabilizes to avoid alert fatigue.
carol_platform: +1. I can adjust the canary-prober sampling window or silence the rule.
alice_m: doing a temporary silence via PD: command: `pagerduty silence add INC-82491 --duration 30m` — done at 05:26 UTC.
pagerduty: Silence applied to INC-82491 for 30 minutes (created by alice_m).
bob_sre: running a quick synthetic sweep: `for r in eu1 eu2 apac; do curl -sS https://prober.$r.internal/health || echo "$r fail"; done` — eu1 now healthy, eu2 intermittent but below threshold.
dave_infra: investigating why the egress change increased conn-limits; hypothesis: new rule changed NAT port allocation causing upstream to hit connection limits on edge proxies. filing root-cause draft.
alice_m: severity decision: Sev-2 (no customer impact) but noisy. will keep incident open for 1h post-stabilization then transition to follow-up.
emma_support: prepping a short support note in case customers ask: "We saw synthetic check failures affecting our internal canary tests; user traffic was not impacted. We're monitoring and will follow up."
ops_watchdog: Created follow-up ticket: ITPROD-546 (owner: dave_infra, priority: high) — includes rollback, change review, and load test.
carol_platform: adding steps for long-term: add extra NAT ports, add per-prober connection backoff, and add a canary isolation policy so synthetic failures don't cascade.
alice_m: handing off to bob_sre for next 45m watch. bob_sre please escalate if anything above 5% 5xx returns.
bob_sre: taking watch. will keep checking dashboards and the PD incident.
incident-bot: Note: INC-82491 comment added by alice_m: "rolled back egress change, silence applied, monitoring. handoff to bob_sre."
alice_m: thanks team. final note before I step off: create postmortem stub and include the exact diff from deploy-1893 -> 1892, timeline, and mitigations.
emma_support: ITPROD-546 updated with customer-notes template and assigned to alice_m for review.
ops_watchdog: Closing loop: last big spike ended at 05:27 UTC; baseline resumed by 05:30 UTC. last_message_ts=1719001890.
carol_platform: will run a targeted load test later tonight to validate NAT limits.
bob_sre: will follow up in the ticket with logs + kernel conntrack stats.
incident-bot: Incident thread summary: synthetic probes experienced transient 5xx oscillation across eu1/eu2 after an egress config change; rollback restored probe health; no user-facing impact; follow-up ticket ITPROD-546 created and assigned.
